network.note: The only permitted HTTP egress is JSON-RPC POST to the configured blockchain node. There is no cloud inference.

mesh.note: Direct A2A peer mesh over raw TCP. Disabled by default. Peers must be listed here or added at runtime, and every dial is re-checked against this list. No rendezvous server, bootstrap URL or web server is ever used.

runtime.note: 500 MiB ceiling enforced by @maotang/agent-client before the model is loaded.
